source_status: Connected type/error migration remains believed source-complete; this is subsequent cohesive quality repair, not gate weakening.
plan: Move the existing simulation quest-coverage reducer unchanged, including its documentation and macro, into simulation/quest_fixture.rs as the existing illness seeding reducer already uses a real child module. Reexport the actual reducer from simulation facade and point its existing source fixture to its real new owner. No schema/argument/body/error changes.

Move ApprovedPartyAction enum and its kind/execute impl from the authority schema file into strategic/approved_action.rs. Only visibility needed for parent governance changes; preserve Serde tags, variants, dispatch order, typed mission branch and legacy error handling. Parent imports the one canonical type. Add its file to STRATEGIC_SOURCE.

Move development-gallery constants, dispatch, validation and bulk materialization into a real strategic/development_gallery.rs. Extract the three fixed autopsy/outbreak/recurring-threat recipes as cohesive private context-only operations so the gallery dispatcher no longer contains their full bodies. Keep the same index selection, data, seeds, side-effect/return order and debug assertions. No new raw index helper API.

Adapt existing source fixtures to read the real production owner plus the remaining scenario authority where needed. Preserve all test cases, literals and assertions; add no fixture helpers. Include moved source before test-bearing parent units so production_source trimming cannot hide it.

Source-review caller privacy, SDK macro/reducer discovery, module ownership and exact moved blocks, then run only allowed static metadata preservation. Publish only after the refactor source is complete. Use hosted gates/export for relevant reductions; never raise existing ceilings.
limits: No local project tools, parsers or runtime probes. Text editing/metadata and Git/rg only.
No agents, new tests/cases/assertions/helpers, fourth full audit wave, Comment Review, DB operations/generated edits, gate/cache weakening or merge.
No P08 implementation before current acceptance. Original twenty exits stay unchanged.
implementation_refinement: The static scenario cohort is extracted alongside autopsy/outbreak/recurring threat, so all four fixed gallery entries are dispatched uniformly. New public operations precede private recipes; all old data/statements are preserved.
